en.headline: Omart warehouse supermarket opens at MegaBox with long queues
en.dek: The membership-based store from OB Group occupies over 20,000 square feet on the 12th floor of MegaBox in Kowloon Bay and opened on Sunday.
body: A new membership warehouse-style supermarket branded Omart opened on Sunday at the 12th floor of MegaBox in Kowloon Bay, occupying more than 20,000 square feet.

The store is operated by the local online shopping and overseas purchasing platform OB Group. Entry is limited to members, with free membership available for the opening period, and the shop is organised into sections covering beauty products, snacks, beverages, household goods and other items.

Local media reported long queues outside the store on opening day, with some shoppers noting that the line extended across several floors because of capacity limits inside. The organisers have not issued an official statement on the attendance figures.

zh.headline: Omart倉儲式超市於九龍灣MegaBox開幕 門外排長龍
zh.dek: 由OB Group營運的會員制超市佔用MegaBox 12樓逾2萬平方呎空間，周日正式開業。
body: 本地網上購物及海外代購平台OB Group旗下的倉儲式超市Omart，周日在九龍灣MegaBox 12樓開幕，佔地逾2萬平方呎。
店舖採會員制，開幕期間可免費成為會員。場內設有美容、零食、飲品、家居用品等多個專區。
本地媒體報道開幕當日店外出現長龍，有市民指因店內有人數上限，隊伍延伸至其他樓層。主辦方暫未公布入場人數官方數字。
Correction: 更正中文面積單位由「平方品」改為「平方呎」。
